title: Flat quasi-finite chart near a Cohen-Macaulay fibre point
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U an open of T on which f is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let y∈X with f(y)∈U, and suppose the depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of its fibre stalk [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There exist n∈ℕ, an open O of X containing y, a scheme P, a flat locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite] locally finitely presented morphism h:O→P, and a smooth morphism g:P→T of relative dimension n [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], with h followed by g equal to the restriction of f to O. No constancy-of-dimension assertion is included.

source.place: Tag 00RH, proof of the quasi-finite polynomial chart and flat shrinking; Tags 00QE, 00RE, 00R7, 00RC and 0A21 (10).

proof.text: Apply the affine-base chart core to obtain e over an affine open V. Set P to the relative affine space over V and g to its projection followed by V.ι. The affine-space smoothness instance and smooth composition theorem give SmoothOfRelativeDimension n g; the core composition equality is the required equality.

theorem exists_flat_quasiFinite_chart_of_fibre_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (y : X) (ht : f y ∈ U)
    (hdepth :
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (O : X.Opens) (P : Scheme.{u}) (h : O.toScheme ⟶ P) (g : P ⟶ T),
      y ∈ O ∧ Flat h ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite h ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation h ∧
        SmoothOfRelativeDimension n g ∧ h ≫ g = O.ι ≫ f
